title: peer-review
description: Facts about the pull request that produced a commit, used to evaluate the peer review control.

commit.description: The merge commit the pull request produced.

pull_request_url.description: Link to the pull request, null when the commit has no pull request.

author.description: Login of the pull request author.

approvers.description: Distinct logins that submitted an APPROVED review.

independent_approval.description: True when at least one approver contributed no commits to the branch.
